local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local ServiceFramework = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("ServiceFramework"))

-- Core Services
local DataService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("DataService"))

local PetService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("PetService"))
local ZoneService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("ZoneService"))

local MonetizationService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("MonetizationService"))
local RewardService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("RewardService"))

local GameplayService = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("GameplayService"))

ServiceFramework:RegisterService("DataService", DataService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("PetService", PetService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("ZoneService", ZoneService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("MonetizationService", MonetizationService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("RewardService", RewardService)
ServiceFramework:RegisterService("GameplayService", GameplayService)

ServiceFramework:Init()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameDataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("GameData_v1")

local function setupPlayerData(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local candy = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	candy.Name = "Candy"
	candy.Value = 0
	candy.Parent = leaderstats

	local coins = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local rebirths = Instance.new("NumberValue")
	rebirths.Name = "Rebirths"
	rebirths.Value = 0
	rebirths.Parent = leaderstats

	local data = nil
	local success, err = pcall(function()
		data = GameDataStore:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId))
	end)

	if success and data then
		candy.Value = data.Candy or 0
		coins.Value = data.Coins or 0
		rebirths.Value = data.Rebirths or 0
	end
end

local function savePlayerData(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		local data = {
			Candy = leaderstats.Candy.Value,
			Coins = leaderstats.Coins.Value,
			Rebirths = leaderstats.Rebirths.Value
		}
		pcall(function()
			GameDataStore:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), data)
		end)
	end
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(setupPlayerData, player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayerData)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(savePlayerData)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		savePlayerData(player)
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))

local HatchPetEvent = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
HatchPetEvent.Name = "HatchPet"
HatchPetEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

HatchPetEvent.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local random = math.random(1, 100)
	local cumulativeChance = 0
	
	for _, pet in ipairs(PetConfig) do
		cumulativeChance += pet.Chance
		if random <= cumulativeChance then
			-- Logic to add pet to player inventory would go here
			return pet
		end
	end
	return PetConfig[1]
end

--[[
	ServiceFramework
	Professional service management for Candy Cyberpunk Simulator
]]

local ServiceFramework = {}
local Services = {}

function ServiceFramework:RegisterService(name, module)
	Services[name] = module
	print("[ServiceFramework] Registered service: " .. name)
end

function ServiceFramework:GetService(name)
	return Services[name]
end

function ServiceFramework:Init()
	for name, service in pairs(Services) do
		if service.Init then
			service:Init()
		end
	end
	for name, service in pairs(Services) do
		if service.Start then
			task.spawn(function()
				service:Start()
			end)
		end
	end
end

return ServiceFramework

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local RebirthEvent = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
RebirthEvent.Name = "RebirthRequest"
RebirthEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

RebirthEvent.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		local candy = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Candy")
		local rebirths = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Rebirths")
		
		local cost = (rebirths.Value + 1) * 1000
		
		if candy.Value >= cost then
			candy.Value = 0
			rebirths.Value += 1
			-- Reset other stats if needed
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local CandySpawns = workspace:WaitForChild("CandySpawns")
local CANDY_COLORS = {Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 255), Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 100)}

local function spawnCandy()
	local candy = Instance.new("Part")
	candy.Name = "CandyNode"
	candy.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	candy.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-90, 90), 2, math.random(-90, 90))
	candy.Color = CANDY_COLORS[math.random(1, #CANDY_COLORS)]
	candy.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	candy.Anchored = true
	candy.CanCollide = false
	candy.Parent = CandySpawns

	local proximityPrompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	proximityPrompt.ActionText = "Collect Candy"
	proximityPrompt.HoldDuration = 0
	proximityPrompt.Parent = candy

	proximityPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local candyValue = player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Candy")
		if candyValue then
			candyValue.Value += 1
			candy:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

while task.wait(2) do
	if #CandySpawns:GetChildren() < 20 then
		spawnCandy()
	end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local ServiceFramework = require(ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("ServiceFramework"))

local PetService = {}
local SpawnedPets = {} -- PlayerUserId -> {Model}

function PetService:Init()
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		SpawnedPets[player.UserId] = {}
	end)
	
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self:CleanupPets(player)
		SpawnedPets[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

function PetService:CleanupPets(player)
	if SpawnedPets[player.UserId] then
		for _, pet in ipairs(SpawnedPets[player.UserId]) do
			pet:Destroy()
		end
		SpawnedPets[player.UserId] = {}
	end
end

function PetService:GivePet(player, petName)
	local dataService = ServiceFramework:GetService("DataService")
	local playerData = dataService:Get(player)
	
	local petInfo = nil
	for _, p in ipairs(GameConfig.Pets) do
		if p.Name == petName then
			petInfo = p
			break
		end
	end
	
	if petInfo then
		table.insert(playerData.Inventory, {
			Name = petInfo.Name,
			Rarity = petInfo.Rarity,
			UUID = game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false)
		})
		-- For now, auto-equip if possible
		if #playerData.EquippedPets < 3 then
			table.insert(playerData.EquippedPets, playerData.Inventory[#playerData.Inventory].UUID)
			self:SpawnPetsForPlayer(player)
		end
	end
end

function PetService:SpawnPetsForPlayer(player)
	self:CleanupPets(player)
	
	local playerData = ServiceFramework:GetService("DataService"):Get(player)
	for i, uuid in ipairs(playerData.EquippedPets) do
		local petData = nil
		for _, p in ipairs(playerData.Inventory) do
			if p.UUID == uuid then
				petData = p
				break
			end
		end
		
		if petData then
			local petModel = self:CreatePetModel(petData.Name, petData.Rarity)
			petModel.Name = "Pet_" .. player.Name .. "_" .. i
			petModel:SetAttribute("Owner", player.UserId)
			petModel:SetAttribute("Slot", i)
			petModel.Parent = workspace
			table.insert(SpawnedPets[player.UserId], petModel)
		end
	end
end

function PetService:CreatePetModel(name, rarity)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Color = GameConfig.PetRarities[rarity].Color
	
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	
	-- Add visual flair base on rarity
	if rarity == "Legendary" then
		local particle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		particle.Texture = "rbxassetid://111803940069577" -- Star
		particle.Color = ColorSequence.new(GameConfig.PetRarities[rarity].Color)
		particle.Rate = 20
		particle.Parent = part
	end
	
	return part
end

return PetService

		local petData = nil
		for _, p in ipairs(playerData.Inventory) do
			if p.UUID == uuid then
				petData = p
				break
			end
		end
		
		if petData then
			local petModel = self:CreatePetModel(petData.Name, petData.Rarity)
			petModel.Name = "Pet_" .. player.Name .. "_" .. i
			petModel:SetAttribute("Owner", player.UserId)
			petModel:SetAttribute("Slot", i)
			petModel.Parent = workspace
			table.insert(SpawnedPets[player.UserId], petModel)
		end
	end
end

function PetService:CreatePetModel(name, rarity)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Color = GameConfig.PetRarities[rarity].Color
	
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	
	-- Add visual flair base on rarity
	if rarity == "Legendary" then
		local particle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		particle.Texture = "rbxassetid://111803940069577" -- Star
		particle.Color = ColorSequence.new(GameConfig.PetRarities[rarity].Color)
		particle.Rate = 20
		particle.Parent = part
	end
	
	return part
end

return PetService
